plugins.name: skill-shrinker
plugins.description: Shrink bloated Claude Code skill/agent/command files using ABCD four-class extraction: bash/Python logic to scripts/, shared params to manifest-schema.json, design notes to DESIGN.md. Dual-track output: stable (SKILL.md ≤220 lines) or growth (≤80 lines + Phase agents). Three modes: full shrink (>500 lines), proposal (200-500 lines), reject (<200 lines).
